name: Machine Learning Engineer
description: Train neural networks and build AI systems that shape the future. Start as a code monkey grinding through datasets, then ascend to architect roles where algorithms bend to your will—or pivot to the dark side of corporate power.

branches.name: Base Track
branches.description: The grueling path from junior developer to elite ML architect.

levels.title: Data Janitor
levels.description: You clean messy datasets and label images of cats for 12 hours a day.
levels.promotion_message: You've been hired as a Data Janitor. Welcome to the grind—your keyboard awaits its punishment.

levels.title: Junior ML Developer
levels.description: You implement basic models while senior devs take credit for your work.
levels.promotion_message: You're now a Junior ML Developer. The coffee machine is your closest friend.

levels.title: ML Developer
levels.description: You train neural networks and debug gradient descent failures at 2 AM.
levels.promotion_message: Promoted to ML Developer! Your models are finally converging—unlike your work-life balance.

levels.title: Senior ML Engineer
levels.description: You architect complex pipelines and mentor juniors who remind you of your former self.
levels.promotion_message: You're now a Senior ML Engineer. People actually listen when you speak in meetings.

levels.title: ML Architect
levels.description: You design cutting-edge systems that other companies will copy in six months.
levels.promotion_message: Promoted to ML Architect! Your whiteboard diagrams are now considered art.

branches.name: Research Scientist
branches.description: Push the boundaries of AI research and publish papers that advance the field.

levels.title: Research Scientist
levels.description: You explore novel architectures and occasionally discover something that actually works.
levels.promotion_message: You've become a Research Scientist. Your Git commits are now cited in academic papers.

levels.title: Principal Research Scientist
levels.description: You lead research teams and your name appears on breakthrough papers.
levels.promotion_message: Promoted to Principal Research Scientist! Conference keynotes are now part of your routine.

levels.title: Distinguished Scientist
levels.description: You set the research agenda and your ideas shape the industry's direction.
levels.promotion_message: You're now a Distinguished Scientist. Grad students cite your work in their dissertations.

levels.title: AI Research Fellow
levels.description: You work on moonshot projects with unlimited resources and minimal oversight.
levels.promotion_message: Promoted to AI Research Fellow! You now have the freedom to pursue any idea, no matter how ambitious.

levels.title: Chief AI Scientist
levels.description: You define the future of artificial intelligence from your ivory tower.
levels.promotion_message: You've reached the pinnacle: Chief AI Scientist. Your theories will outlive you.

branches.name: Tech Overlord
branches.description: Abandon ethics and innovation for power, profit, and ruthless corporate domination.

levels.title: VP of AI Strategy
levels.description: You monetize AI innovations and convince investors that ethics are just suggestions.
levels.promotion_message: You're now VP of AI Strategy. Shareholder value is your new moral compass.

levels.title: Chief Technology Officer
levels.description: You gut R&D budgets while presenting vaporware demos to gullible board members.
levels.promotion_message: Promoted to CTO! Your PowerPoints are more impressive than your actual technology.

levels.title: Chief Operating Officer
levels.description: You optimize profits by firing engineers and replacing them with cheaper algorithms.
levels.promotion_message: You're now COO. Layoff announcements and stock buybacks are your specialty.

levels.title: Chief Executive Officer
levels.description: You rule the company with an iron fist, crushing competitors and exploiting users' data for maximum profit.
levels.promotion_message: You've become CEO. Your empire is built on surveillance capitalism and questionable ethics.

levels.title: Tech Monopolist
levels.description: You've transcended mere CEO status to become an untouchable titan who shapes global policy.
levels.promotion_message: You've achieved ultimate power as a Tech Monopolist. Governments consult you, regulators fear you, and your wealth is incalculable.

author: CareerForge
